"""Cost-discrimination scenarios: duplicate query semantics and cost minimisation."""
import itertools, json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import run, prof, query, rec, Checks

c = Checks()

def brute(doc, runs):
    costs = {q['id']: q['cost'] for q in doc['queries']}
    pids = [p['id'] for p in doc['profiles']]
    qids = [q['id'] for q in doc['queries']]
    matrix = {(r['query'], r['profile']):
              (r['rcode'], frozenset((x['owner'], x['type'], x['data']) for x in r['answer']))
              for r in runs}
    pairs = []
    for pa, pb in itertools.combinations(pids, 2):
        diff = {q for q in qids if matrix[q, pa] != matrix[q, pb]}
        if diff:
            pairs.append(diff)
    if not pairs:
        return 0, 0
    best = None
    for size in range(1, len(qids) + 1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(qids, size):
            sel = set(combo)
            if any(not (d & sel) for d in pairs):
                continue
            key = (sum(costs[q] for q in combo), size)
            if best is None or key < best:
                best = key
    return best

# the same name/type under two ids with different costs: the cheaper one is optimal
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('*.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'),
                                                rec('a.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.9')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('rfc', 4), prof('off', 4, 'follow', 'off')],
       'queries': [query('expensive', 'w.test.', 'A', 900),
                   query('cheap', 'W.TEST.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
p = run(doc)
got = json.loads(p[1])
cost, count = brute(doc, got['runs'])
c.check('duplicate-name queries: cost/count',
        (got['diagnostic']['cost'], got['diagnostic']['count']) == (cost, count)
        and (cost, count) == (1, 1), '%s vs brute %s' % (got['diagnostic'], (cost, count)))
c.check('duplicate-name queries: cheapest chosen',
        got['diagnostic']['basis'] == ['cheap'], got['diagnostic']['basis'])

# a case where two queries are needed and the cheap pair is strictly better
doc = {'zones': [
        {'origin': 'one.', 'records': [rec('*.one.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]},
        {'origin': 'two.', 'records': [rec('a.two.', 'CNAME', 'b.two.'),
                                     rec('b.two.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('rfc', 4), prof('off', 4, 'follow', 'off'),
                    prof('stop', 4, 'stop', 'rfc')],
       'queries': [query('wild_only', 'q.one.', 'A', 7),
                   query('chain_only', 'a.two.', 'A', 5),
                   query('neutral', 'missing.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
p = run(doc)
got = json.loads(p[1])
cost, count = brute(doc, got['runs'])
c.check('two-way split optimum', (got['diagnostic']['cost'], got['diagnostic']['count']) == (cost, count),
        '%s vs %s' % (got['diagnostic'], (cost, count)))
matrix = {(r['query'], r['profile']):
          (r['rcode'], frozenset((x['owner'], x['type'], x['data']) for x in r['answer']))
          for r in got['runs']}
pids = sorted(p['id'] for p in doc['profiles'])
for pa, pb in itertools.combinations(pids, 2):
    diff = {q['id'] for q in doc['queries'] if matrix[q['id'], pa] != matrix[q['id'], pb]}
    if diff:
        c.check('basis distinguishes %s/%s' % (pa, pb),
                bool(diff & set(got['diagnostic']['basis'])), diff)

# greedy trap: the globally cheapest query cannot distinguish the off/stop pair
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 't.', 'records': [rec('*.t.', 'TXT', 'x'),
                                             rec('a.t.', 'CNAME', 'b.t.'),
                                             rec('b.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('rfc', 1), prof('off', 1, 'follow', 'off'), prof('stop', 1, 'stop', 'rfc')],
       'queries': [query('cheap_useless', 'b.t.', 'A', 1),
                   query('wild', 'q.t.', 'TXT', 4),
                   query('chain', 'a.t.', 'A', 4)],
       'observations': []}
p = run(doc)
got = json.loads(p[1])
cost, count = brute(doc, got['runs'])
c.check('greedy trap optimum', (got['diagnostic']['cost'], got['diagnostic']['count']) == (cost, count),
        '%s vs %s' % (got['diagnostic'], (cost, count)))
c.check('greedy trap count is 2', got['diagnostic']['count'] == 2, got['diagnostic'])

sys.exit(c.done('cost selection tests'))
